# Angular template syntax cache

Synthetic source only. No ignore-file or path-name mappings are needed.
`page.html` covers Angular attribute classifications, blocks, non-bindable and
dropped elements, namespaced/void/self-closing elements and grammar recovery.
`decorators.ts` covers alias-preserving class metadata, inline source mapping
and every inadmissible inline form. Tests create CRLF copies in temporary
directories; no generated files belong in this fixture.
